elements.quote: Only six studies reported the prevalence of CAM (223 patients) among a pooled sample size of 52,916 COVID-19 patients with a mean age of 62.12 ± 9.69 years [53-56]. COVID-19 was confirmed based on reverse transcription polymerase chain reactions (RT-PCR) in all the included studies except the study by Ramaswami et al. 2021, and mucormycosis was confirmed based on histopathology, culture or staining [53]. The majority of the studies reporting CAM prevalence were from India ( n = 4) [53-56], whereas a single study was from Turkey [63] and Pakistan [64].
